exercises.title: Present Simple — Recupera
exercises.description: Ricostruisci uso, forma, domande, negative e posizione degli avverbi di frequenza prima della pratica.
exercises.instructions: Leggi la spiegazione, osserva gli esempi e controlla subito se la regola è chiara.

sections.title: Capisci e prova subito
sections.instructions: Non memorizzare una tabella: collega ogni forma al significato e poi usala.

questions.title: Present Simple: quello che devi saper usare
questions.instructions: Leggi le regole e osserva cosa cambia con il soggetto.
questions.learning_objective: Use the present simple for routines and facts with correct verb forms, questions, negatives and frequency-adverb position.

content.body: Usa il Present Simple per routine, abitudini e fatti. Con he/she/it il verbo cambia; nelle domande e negative usa do/does e il verbo torna alla forma base.
content.intro: Il punto non è solo aggiungere -s: devi riconoscere quando usare il tempo e sapere cosa succede al verbo in affermative, domande e negative.

sections.title: Routine, abitudini e fatti
sections.body: Usa il Present Simple per ciò che succede regolarmente o è generalmente vero, non per descrivere ciò che sta succedendo proprio adesso.

examples.text: I walk to school every day.
My aunt works in a hospital.

sections.title: Il verbo cambia con he, she, it
sections.body: Con I/you/we/they usa la forma base. Con he/she/it aggiungi normalmente -s; alcuni verbi prendono -es o cambiano -y in -ies.

sections.title: Do/does porta la persona
sections.body: Nelle domande e nelle negative dei verbi normali, do/does indica la persona. Dopo do, does, don't e doesn't il verbo resta alla forma base.
sections.pattern: Does + he/she/it + base verb? · he/she/it + doesn't + base verb

sections.title: Non mettere due volte la terza persona
sections.body: Se c'è does o doesn't, non aggiungere anche -s al verbo principale.

sections.title: Be funziona da solo
sections.body: Con be usi am/is/are e non do/does. Per fare una domanda sposti be prima del soggetto; per la negativa aggiungi not.

sections.title: Dove metto usually, often, never?
sections.body: Con un verbo normale l'avverbio di frequenza viene di solito prima del verbo. Con be viene dopo am/is/are.

examples.text: She is often tired after training.

sections.title: Prima di continuare
points: Usually/often/never: prima del verbo, dopo be.

questions.title: Quando lo usi?
questions.prompt: Marta works at a café near the station.
questions.instructions: Che cosa comunica qui il Present Simple?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise the routine/fact use of the present simple.

options.text: È un fatto stabile della sua vita/lavoro.
Sta lavorando proprio in questo momento.
Ha lavorato lì in passato ma non più.

feedback.explanation: Works descrive qui un fatto abituale/stabile. Per un'azione in corso useresti il Present Continuous.

questions.title: La forma cambia con il soggetto
questions.instructions: Scegli la forma corretta del verbo.
questions.learning_objective: Use the base form and third-person singular correctly.

content.text_template: My cousins [[blank_1]] in Bologna, but my sister [[blank_2]] in Modena.

feedback.explanation: My cousins = they → live. My sister = she → lives.

questions.title: Doesn't + verbo base
questions.prompt: Correggi: He doesn't works on Saturdays.
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb after doesn't.

accepted_answers: He does not work on Saturdays.

feedback.explanation: Doesn't contiene già la terza persona: il verbo principale torna a work.

questions.title: Costruisci la domanda
questions.learning_objective: Build a present simple information question with does.

feedback.explanation: Con un question word: Where + does + soggetto + verbo base?

questions.title: Be al presente
questions.prompt: Completa con la forma corretta di be.
questions.learning_objective: Use am/is/are with the correct subject.

content.text_template: My parents [[blank_1]] at work and I [[blank_2]] at home today.

feedback.explanation: My parents = they → are. I → am.

exercises.title: Present Simple — Allenati
exercises.description: Pratica mista su forma, terza persona, domande, negative, short answers e frequenza senza rileggere la regola.
exercises.instructions: Lavora a memoria. Usa il feedback per capire il tipo di errore, non solo la risposta.

sections.title: Forma e uso in contesto
sections.instructions: Le frasi cambiano soggetto e contesto: decidi ogni volta quale struttura serve.

questions.title: Quali frasi funzionano?
questions.learning_objective: Recognise correct present simple affirmative, negative and question forms.

options.text: My dad drives to work every day.
Does your friend lives nearby?
We don't eat lunch at school.
Sara study English on Tuesday.

feedback.explanation: Dopo does serve live, mentre Sara richiede studies/studies depending verb: con study → studies.

questions.title: Una routine completa
questions.prompt: Completa il testo con il Present Simple.
questions.instructions: Scrivi la forma corretta del verbo suggerito dal contesto.
questions.learning_objective: Produce present simple forms in a short connected routine text.

content.text_template: Leo [[blank_1]] up at seven. His parents [[blank_2]] home before him, so he [[blank_3]] breakfast alone. He [[blank_4]] coffee, and he [[blank_5]] the bus to school.

feedback.explanation: Controlla ogni soggetto separatamente: Leo/he richiede la terza persona; his parents = they usa la forma base.

questions.title: Domanda con do
questions.learning_objective: Build a present simple question with do.

feedback.explanation: What time + do + subject + base verb.

questions.title: Dopo does
questions.prompt: Correggi: Does Anna goes to the gym after school?
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb after does in a question.

accepted_answers: Does Anna go to the gym after school?

feedback.explanation: Does porta già la terza persona; il verbo resta go.

questions.title: Short answer
questions.learning_objective: Use do/does in a present simple short answer.

content.text_template: Does your sister play volleyball? — Yes, she [[blank_1]].

feedback.explanation: La domanda usa does e la short answer riprende lo stesso ausiliare: Yes, she does.

questions.title: Avverbio di frequenza
questions.learning_objective: Place a frequency adverb before a main verb.

feedback.explanation: Con un verbo normale, usually viene prima di walk.

questions.title: Produci la frase
questions.prompt: Traduci: Mio fratello non guarda mai la TV dopo cena.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a third-person present simple negative with a frequency adverb.

accepted_answers: My brother never watches TV after dinner.
My brother never watches television after dinner.

feedback.explanation: Never rende già negativa l'idea: My brother never watches..., senza doesn't.

questions.title: Be non usa do/does
questions.learning_objective: Form a present simple question with be without do/does.

options.text: Are your classmates ready?
Do your classmates are ready?
Does your classmates ready?

feedback.explanation: Con be, sposti are prima del soggetto: Are your classmates ready?

exercises.title: Present Simple — Modalità scuola
exercises.description: Formati tipici da verifica: completamento di testo, correzione, riordino e traduzione senza suggerimenti sulla regola.
exercises.instructions: Lavora come in una verifica. Le correzioni vengono mostrate alla fine della sezione.

sections.title: Verifica in formati scolastici
sections.instructions: Non ci sono regole sopra le domande: scegli la struttura dal contesto.

questions.title: Complete the text
questions.prompt: Complete the text with the correct Present Simple form.
questions.instructions: Scrivi la forma completa richiesta in ogni spazio.
questions.learning_objective: Complete a school-style connected text using present simple forms.

content.text_template: Nina [[blank_1]] near her school. She [[blank_2]] home at 7:30 and [[blank_3]] the bus. Her lessons [[blank_4]] at 8:15. She [[blank_5]] lunch at school because her parents [[blank_6]] nearby.

feedback.explanation: Controlla il soggetto di ogni verbo: il testo alterna she e soggetti plurali.

questions.title: Correct the sentence
questions.prompt: Correct: My friends doesn't study French.
questions.learning_objective: Correct auxiliary agreement in a present simple negative.

accepted_answers: My friends do not study French.

feedback.explanation: My friends = they, quindi don't.

questions.title: Correct the question
questions.learning_objective: Add the required auxiliary and form a present simple question.

feedback.explanation: Where + does + your teacher + work?

questions.title: Put the words in order
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a present simple question from scrambled elements.

feedback.explanation: How often + does + Luca + go...?

questions.title: Translate
questions.prompt: Traduci: Di solito tua sorella torna a casa a piedi?
questions.learning_objective: Translate a present simple frequency question accurately.

accepted_answers: Does your sister usually walk home?
Does your sister usually go home on foot?

feedback.explanation: Does + subject + usually + base verb. Walk home è una resa naturale di tornare a casa a piedi.

questions.title: Choose the correct sentence
questions.learning_objective: Recognise a correct third-person present simple sentence with a frequency adverb.

options.text: Tom often plays video games after dinner.
Tom plays often video games after dinner.
Tom often play video games after dinner.

feedback.explanation: Often viene prima del verbo normale e Tom richiede plays.

exercises.title: Present Simple — Mini-verifica
exercises.description: Controllo breve e bilanciato senza spiegazioni preventive.
exercises.instructions: Rispondi senza consultare la spiegazione. Il risultato serve a capire se questo argomento può essere considerato stabile.

sections.title: Mini-verifica
sections.instructions: Le domande coprono uso, forma, domande, negative, be e frequenza.

questions.title: Use
questions.prompt: Every Friday, our class ___ in the language lab.
questions.learning_objective: Choose present simple for a repeated routine.

options.text: works
is working
worked

feedback.explanation: Every Friday indica una routine ripetuta.

questions.title: Third person spelling
questions.learning_objective: Apply third-person spelling accurately.

content.text_template: My cousin [[blank_1]] English and German at school.

feedback.explanation: Con consonante + y, study diventa studies.

questions.title: Negative
questions.instructions: Write the complete negative verb form.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a third-person present simple negative.

feedback.explanation: Emma = she: doesn't + eat.

questions.title: Question
questions.learning_objective: Build a third-person present simple question.

feedback.explanation: Does + subject + base verb.

questions.title: Base verb after does
questions.learning_objective: Keep the main verb in the base form after does.

options.text: Does he speak Spanish?
Does he speaks Spanish?
Do he speak Spanish?

feedback.explanation: He richiede does; dopo does il verbo è speak.

questions.title: Frequency adverb
questions.learning_objective: Place a frequency adverb correctly with a main verb.

options.text: We usually have lunch at home.
We have usually lunch at home.
We have lunch usually at home.

feedback.explanation: Usually viene normalmente prima del verbo have.

questions.title: Be
questions.learning_objective: Choose the correct present form of be.

content.text_template: The classrooms [[blank_1]] on the second floor.

feedback.explanation: The classrooms è plurale: are.

questions.title: Final production
questions.prompt: Traduci: I miei genitori lavorano a casa due giorni alla settimana.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a natural present simple sentence about a repeated routine.

accepted_answers: My parents work from home two days a week.
My parents work at home two days a week.

feedback.explanation: My parents = they, quindi work senza -s. Two days a week esprime la frequenza.
